note: Real digests for version 0.5.0, built from the plugin repository's main branch at commit 0ea127ff2e8f (make release-with-prebuilt-fpp10 VERSION=0.5.0). This version adds the action subcommand, serves the macro and action lists to FPP's command editor, and lets FPP force a power down and end a night session. Those exact artifacts are published as the v0.5.0 pre-release on ShowMeshSystems/showmesh-fpp-plugin, the default artifact host. Regenerate this file from the manifest whenever a new release is cut; there is no tooling that does it automatically. The three native-prebuilt-fpp10 objects were built once each against FPP 10.0 on an Apple Silicon Mac under Docker Desktop; no second host has rebuilt and compared them.
